title: Homemade Pumpkin Purée
description: Silky smooth pumpkin purée made from a whole Hokkaido pumpkin — use in breads, pies and pancakes.
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C / 400°F. Wash the pumpkin.
Remove stems; halve; scoop out seeds with a spoon.
Place cut-side down on parchment-lined baking sheet.
Cut into cubes; blend 2–3 minutes until smooth. Transfer to a bowl.
notes: Seeds can be roasted at 200°C for 20 minutes as a snack. Keeps in fridge up to 1 week. Butternut squash works as a substitute.
